posts.description: INNOVATION AI LIMITED, inventors and engineers behind innovative new embodied technologies for enhanced human-computer interaction, are hiring. Salary will be HK$23,000. Overall, the Software Engineer for INNOVATION AI LIMITED should be familiar with the concepts of programming evolutions for producing electronic music through peripheral devices, which, in the case of the company, include but are not limited to the following: (1) Pressure/Motion/Neurological/Haptic sensors. The engineer will be required to create numerous profiles of being able to create sound in various physical ways using the above components, and will need to conduct research into user data in order to develop cognitive and realistic scenarios of where making music using the above components will be needed. (2) User Research and Analysis. Conduct extensive user research to understand the target audience's needs, preferences, and expectations regarding wearable technology and music creation. Gather user feedback through surveys, interviews, and usability testing to inform the app's design and features. (3) Technology Assessment and Compatibility: Evaluate the company's current technologies, research, and identify its capabilities and its limitations. Assess the compatibility of the device with different operating systems (iOS, Android, Mac, and Windows) to ensure seamless integration. (4) Gesture Recognition and Mapping: Research and develop robust algorithms for accurate gesture recognition using motion and pressure sensors embedded inthe wearable technology. Investigate machine learning and pattern recognition techniques to interpret and map these gestures to specific musical parameters. (5) Sound Design and Effects: Create an extensive library of high-quality sounds and effects that users can access and manipulate through their gestures. Employ advanced signal processing techniques to enhance sound quality, minimize latency, and provide a wide range of creative possibilities.
